articles.title: Consultations ongoing for introducing tenders for offshore wind in Tamil Nadu: Official
articles.description: Consultations are ongoing for introducing a new tender for wind offshore technology in Tamil Nadu, Rajesh Kulhari, Joint Secretary at the Union Renewable Ministry told reporters addressing them ahead of the Windergy India, 2026.

articles.title: Assam Brahmaputra underwater tunnel: 15.7 km road-cum-rail link gets major push; Rs 11,982 cr tender invited
articles.description: The Brahmaputra tunnel in Assam has moved ahead with NHIDCL inviting bids worth Rs 11,982 cr for its construction. The underwater road-cum-rail link is part of the Gohpur-Numaligarh corridor, which will provide a new connection between Gohpur on NH-15 and Numaligarh on NH-715.

articles.title: UP Wins 3 National GeM Awards; Govt Procurement Crosses ₹1 Lakh Crore, MSMEs Get Major Boost
articles.description: Uttar Pradesh has received three national awards for excellence in Government e-Marketplace (GeM) procurement. Since GeM’s launch, the state has completed purchases worth over ₹1 lakh crore, including ₹55,972 crore from MSMEs. MSE participation has increased from 43% to 59% in four years, while women entrepreneurs, startups and small businesses have gained wider access to government markets.

articles.title: OPINION | India’s defence procurement is creating sovereign capabilities. Every government buyer must emulate it
articles.description: The DAP and the sixth indigenisation list deliver something no Indian buyer has offered before, which is a decade of visible demand at component depth. This is the framework that Railways, Power, Telecom, Health and the states can adopt at almost no additional fiscal cost
